content: Pinned source shows forward video flow: kycontroller creates endpoints and spawns kyavserver; kyavservice configures txproto capture/FFmpeg encode; encoded AVPacket codec/media records are sent through a kycom endpoint, kyproto over QUIC/TLS, a client kycom bridge, then kyvlcplayer/libVLC. Reverse input is bidirectional InputPacket traffic between a client kynput pipeline and Linux host kynput service. Clipboard types exist on Linux and Windows but the pinned macOS pipeline has no clipboard producer/consumer.
